summary: Seed minimal CURRENT.md on import-payload when absent (#618): adoption note, capability index, CI guidance without generic-template placeholder; skip if present; points agents to .agentic/releases/ for durable evidence.
migration_impact: import-payload dry-run/apply may create CURRENT.md when missing. Existing CURRENT.md is never overwritten. Greenfield and adopt checkouts satisfy validate_plate_repo current-md presence check.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core so import-payload seeds CURRENT.md.
2. After apply, edit CURRENT.md rows or migrate claims into .agentic/releases/ fragments.
3. Do not reintroduce the generic-template CI placeholder phrase in CURRENT.md.
agent_notes: After import, if CURRENT.md was created, fill real capability rows when Features land. Prefer fragments under .agentic/releases/unreleased/ for process changes.
